criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 23 June 2029 (24 months after the 23 June 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Galloway Logistics plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 23 June 2029 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 23 June 2031 (48 months after Closing).

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Galloway Logistics plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (24 months) and as a date (23 June 2029), with days remaining from 27 May 2027 (758 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
